description: For a target person, summarize all engagement evidence between them and your collected posts: posts they reacted to, posts they commented on, frequency, recency, reaction kinds, comment text snippets. Computes a v0 warmth score from engagement count, comment signal, and recency. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.
